name: Fondo Nacional del Ahorro
body: Descriptions and share cards on every page analyzed, Consent Mode that starts in denied, and every link opened answered. But Ahorro, Cesantías, and other product pages name the home page as their canonical URL.
lesson: Give each page a self-referencing canonical. Pointing it home asks search to drop the page from results.
summary: www.fna.gov.co scores 86 out of 100 (B). 0 checks fail now, 19 are at risk, and 19 pass. Fix first: 19 pages name another URL as canonical.

fix.title: 19 pages name another URL as canonical
fix.evidence: /personas/ahorro → /, /personas/ahorro/retiros → /, /personas/ahorro/afiliacion → /, /personas/cesantias → / and 15 more. Search engines will usually index the other URL instead.
fix.fix: Make each page's canonical point at itself unless it is a real duplicate.

fix.title: The sitemap lists 2 pages search engines should not index
fix.fix: List only live, canonical, indexable URLs in the sitemap.

fix.title: 51 images have no width or height
fix.evidence: The layout jumps when they load, which hurts Cumulative Layout Shift.
fix.fix: Set width and height (or aspect-ratio) on images.

fix.title: No Organization or Person entity describes who is behind the site
fix.evidence: AI answers lean on this to name the brand, its logo, and its profiles. The page links 7 profiles that could go in sameAs.
fix.fix: Add Organization (or Person) JSON-LD with name, url, logo, and sameAs. The fix kit has a draft.

fix.title: 1 cookie is sent without Secure
fix.evidence: Without Secure: cookiesession1. Set on /, /personas/ahorro, /personas/ahorro/retiros and 17 more.
fix.fix: Set Secure on every cookie, and HttpOnly plus SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

fix.title: The content security policy has gaps
fix.fix: Replace 'unsafe-inline' with nonces or hashes, limit hosts, and add object-src 'none' and base-uri 'self'.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http does not serve the site
Every image has an alt attribute
Every page has a meta description
Language alternates point at each other
